    resolve(Type t, Type declaredType, MethodSignature reference, SootMethod container, ChunkedQueue<SootMethod> targets)
    Adds the method that a receiver of type t runs for a call to reference: the override of the method reference resolves to, which is not always the first method with the same sub-signature (a private or a package-private method from another package does not override).
